static_traits.name: Lin An宁
static_traits.social_status: 目前社会Weak support system，Feels isolated；与同事关系因Self-doubt而紧张
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理治疗史；此前not yet有类似心理问题报道
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、有条理；合作度高，Positive attitude；在谈及错误时略显紧张和not安，能进行自我Reflection并愿意按结构记录数据

basic_info.main_problem: 最近在Work中犯了一次错误后，持续出现Self-doubt与not足感，认为自己not胜任这份Work，且将这次错误视为能力的定义，导致日常在处理重要文件时均感到Anxiety与not安。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not足感影响了我在Work的自信并造成显著困扰，我希望通过咨询减轻这种not胜任感，Recovery在Work中的信心。
growth_experiences: 原生家庭：Mother为芭蕾舞Actor，Father信息缺失。成长史中not yet报告重大身心疾病或既往心理治疗经历。

special_situations.event: A few weeks ago, a filing error occurred in medical records work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯一次错，就证明我not胜任这份Work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterwards, at work, excessively cautious, repeatedly checks and slows down to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这一错足以说明我not合格

special_situations.event: Every day when handling important documents or key tasks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次犯错，会带来严重后果并进一步证明我能力not足
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids complex or self-perceived high-risk tasks, procrastinates submission to reduce exposure to evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might mess up again, and the consequences will be terrible

special_situations.event: When interacting with colleagues or receiving feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they notice my mistake, they will look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces contact with colleagues; keeps a low profile to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我not专业、在看not起我

special_situations.event: When alone recalling that work mistake and repeatedly replaying the error scene in his mind
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有完全not犯错才算合格；好的表现not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我批评、集中注意于负面细节以强迫自己改进
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我只看到错误，其他都not重要

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, to prove oneself competent and valuable
core_conflict.fear: Fears being belittled, humiliated, or excluded for making mistakes
defense_goal: 通过自我批评与过度谨慎来控制风险、避免暴露not足
Keeps a certain distance from others to reduce chances of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A flawed, error-prone person who needs to be extra careful
object_relations.object_representation: A harsh judge (colleagues / superiors who discover and amplify mistakes at any time)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes conducting a 'controllable small mistake' behavioral experiment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将此理解为对能力的检验：如果失败就会暴露自己的not胜任（移情为对权威评判的担忧）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以客观、步骤化的语气回应，反复确认流程与细节，减少情绪表达，以控制not确定性。

manifestations: Currently lacks strong social support, feels facing work pressure alone
因Self-doubtTense relationships with colleagues，减少互动
outcomes: Decreased work efficiency、错误反而增多
Hesitating to seek help when support is needed

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When discussing experiments, repeatedly confirms steps to ensure 'doing it right'
Being overly cautious at work, slowing down

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 将“not能犯错/必须完美”视为硬性自我Demands
把一次错误等同于整体能力的negate

positive_force: 愿意求助并积极配合咨询，动机Good
Has willingness for self-observation and recording (willing to do behavioral experiments and collect data)
能够识do not负性Automatic thoughts并愿意挑战它们
Responsible, able to proactively correct mistakes and seek improvement
negative_force: Excessive self-criticism and excessively high standards, tending to equate mistakes with failure
Cognitive distortions: overgeneralization, labeling, personalization, mental filtering

Weak social support，Feels isolated，关系受压

target_behavior.behavior: 在Work中因Anxiety而过度谨慎、反复检查并放慢速度
antecedent: Recalling the filing mistake from a few weeks ago
When handling important documents or key tasks
When interacting with colleagues or receiving feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次错误过度概括为“我not称职”，并对再次犯错持灾难化Anticipation
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与再犯错误的感知风险，短时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Work速度变慢、注意力受损，错误反而增多；Intensifying self-doubt、Tense relationships with colleagues
